  01 / REAL ESTATE ANALYTICS · BOSTON UNIVERSITYCanarsie market entry.Should a real estate brokerage open an office in this Brooklyn neighborhood?
  The approachI combined NYC sales data with neighborhood clustering, local pricing models, quarterly forecasting, and financial scenario analysis in R.RClusteringRegressionETSNPVIndividual academic project · AD 571 · 2026
  What I foundTHE MARKETFocus on the core.Standard properties represented 48.3% of the clustered sample, offering the largest initial listing pool.THE MODELUse local context.A citywide model overpredicted Canarsie prices. Local pricing and neighborhood knowledge matter.THE DECISIONEnter lean.The assignment model favored a 4.3% commission and no salaried staff. Returns turned negative in the conservative scenario.
  Explore the full workThe complete analysis, charts, and model assumptions are in the original project files.R notebook ↓Presentation ↓Write-up ↓Workbook ↓Academic findings under assignment assumptions. Samples differ by analytical stage; results summarize the original project.
